method: Two independent reviewer agents with no shared context, started from the same prompt scope (the fix commits after the squash) and asked only for defects; findings were verified against the code and either fixed in a follow-up commit or recorded with a reason.

reviews.scope: logic, safety, Dockerfiles, workflows, supply-chain pins

findings.finding: Root CI check job cannot start nextest: the runtime profile's package overrides do not match the root workspace
findings.commit: fix(ci): runtime nextest profile moves under runtime/

findings.finding: cargo test --test bridge_protocol ran under static RUSTFLAGS without --target, which rustc refuses for the thiserror proc-macro
findings.commit: ci(root): run the root workspace under nextest's default profile and test the static ELF in its own step

findings.finding: Syft cataloger name rust-audit-binary-cataloger does not exist; the real name is cargo-auditable-binary-cataloger
Gateway process fixture set a Sentry DSN as the TIKA__ inheritance probe, causing network side effects
Free-text terminal reasons became Sentry failure classes
Panic line used Rust Debug escaping, not JSON

findings.disposition: fixed (presence check; the checksum proves identity)

findings.finding: docs: admission_invariant reason, single-report claim, 'dependency-free' wording, bridge test platform
dpkg-query -S diversion lines could yield a bogus package name
findings.disposition: accepted: fails closed; no diversion in the Tesseract closure

reviews.scope: tests exercising each behaviour, weakened gates, CI wiring, port fidelity, flakiness

findings.finding: Root check job unreachable (same as C1)
findings.commit: fix(ci): runtime nextest profile moves under runtime/

findings.finding: Static RUSTFLAGS reach the bridge protocol test (same as C2)
Lockfile guard omitted the proof crates' lockfiles; shellcheck not pinned
Untested: terminal once-guard, CacheError::class, Miette codes, gateway refusal through HTTP, quiet log filter vs export
Untested: maxFiles=-1 failure mode, /livez removal, span fields, cpu_dispatch event, panic hook, internal-logs
findings.disposition: accepted with reason: the first three are exercised only by the hosted Tika deployment gate and OTLP trace gate; span attributes and the dispatch event are observable in the retained trace/log evidence of that gate; a panic test cannot run under panic=abort inside libtest

findings.finding: StackReadiness tests of scripts/smoke_stack.py dropped with the Python bridge test
findings.disposition: accepted: they tested the legacy Python baseline harness scheduled for removal in the cleanup review

findings.finding: Reply::Close sends FIN instead of the original RST
findings.disposition: accepted and documented in the test: the adapter treats EOF and reset alike (exit 1)

findings.finding: Drip deadline measured outside the peer scope
request_allocations requires identical counters across warmed requests
findings.disposition: accepted: one warm request precedes the measured ones; the gate exists to surface lazily-initialised paths
